name: sai_multi_agent_handoff
description: S'Ai-style multi-agent run. The router/parent streams a brief intro, hands off to a specialist sub-agent which streams the substantive answer, then the parent re-emits the same answer (echo) which the client must suppress so the sub-agent's bubble is not duplicated.

payload.delta: — let me bring in our therapist.

payload.content: One moment — let me bring in our therapist.
Hi, I'm here to listen. Could you tell me a little about what's on your mind?
